description: Results of five kill tests for the discrete AQUAL operator on cubic graph

kill_tests.name: Newton and MOND Recovery
kill_tests.description: Operator must recover g ∝ r⁻² (Newton) and g ∝ r⁻¹ (deep MOND)

kill_tests.name: Prefactor Convergence
kill_tests.description: Deep-MOND prefactor C = g_AQUAL / √(a₀ g_N) must converge
kill_tests.interpretation: C ≠ 1 means graph does not reproduce standard MOND. Effective a₀,eff = C²a₀ ≈ 5.4 a₀

kill_tests.name: Mass Scaling
kill_tests.description: In standard MOND, r_trans ∝ M^0.5. Measured exponent is 0.18.
kill_tests.interpretation: Λ-locking dominates over local mass in setting transition radius. Structural consequence of Λ-proportional reservoir term.

kill_tests.name: Broken Superposition
kill_tests.description: Nonlinear superposition violation for two equal point masses
kill_tests.configuration: Two equal masses separated by d = 8a
kill_tests.interpretation: Arises from nonlinear μ-function; expected from any AQUAL-type operator

kill_tests.name: External Field Effect
kill_tests.description: Enhancement must decrease with external field strength
kill_tests.note: Qualitative in this test; quantitative measurement requires galaxy-pair boundary conditions

cosmological_stability.description: Minimal consistency check against BOSS DR12 fσ₈
cosmological_stability.interpretation: σ₈ suppressed by 0.7%, consistent with S₈ tension direction. Stability check, not a fit.
